column3: The Hebrew says Esther put on royalty; BSB supplies royal attire.
The Hebrew commands them to hurry Haman to do Esther’s word; BSB expands this to bring Haman so that we can do her request.
The Hebrew calls this a banquet of wine; BSB describes them drinking their wine.
The Hebrew says tomorrow she will do according to the king’s word; BSB says she will answer his question and places tomorrow with the invitation.
The Hebrew says he sent and brought his friends and wife; BSB describes calling for them.
The Hebrew says to make a wooden structure or tree and later says Haman made it; BSB specifies gallows and describes having them constructed.
